catalysts.headline: AKAM shares fell 8.23% to close at $91.71, the latest leg of a volatile Oct 9-14 stretch that also included a ~6% single-session drop on Oct 10; no specific company news event was identified as the cause in sources reviewed. A technical signal (50-day moving average crossing below the 200-day) occurred on Oct 5, per one technical-analysis source.
catalysts.impact: Continues a multi-week decline from the ~$107.91 level seen in late September

catalysts.headline: Akamai signs 7-year, $11.6B compute/cloud deal with Anthropic (potentially up to ~$20B with additional commitments); issues Anthropic a warrant for up to ~5% of common shares at $111.33 strike (~2% vesting now)
catalysts.impact: Stock jumped — magnitude disputed across sources (see conflicts); company said the deal does not change 2026 revenue guidance and no revenue is expected from it in 2026

catalysts.headline: Announced expanded 7-year, $11.6B cloud services deal with Anthropic (option to scale to ~$20B total) to support Anthropic's CPU compute workloads on Akamai Cloud; issued Anthropic a warrant for up to ~5% of Akamai shares at a $111.33/share strike; also disclosed a ~$1.7B hardware supply arrangement with Lenovo and contract manufacturer Jabil for memory components. Deal is >6x the size of a ~$1.8B Akamai-Anthropic deal reported in May 2026 and is described as the largest in Akamai's history.
catalysts.impact: strongly positive (shares surged; magnitude disputed across sources)

catalysts.headline: Q2 2026 results: revenue $1.10B (+5% YoY); GAAP diluted EPS $0.52 (-27% YoY); non-GAAP diluted EPS $1.59 (-8% YoY); Cloud Infrastructure Services revenue +39-40% YoY; FY2026 guidance: revenue $4.445B-$4.530B (6-8% growth), non-GAAP EPS $6.40-$7.05

HSBC downgraded Akamai to Hold from Buy and cut its price target to $123 from $171, citing weaker cloud infrastructure margins, slower earnings growth, and elevated capital spending (lowered valuation multiple to 17x estimated near-term EPS from 25x)
catalysts.impact: Shares fell in after-hours trading on the note, then rebounded roughly 5% the next session per one source

catalysts.headline: Akamai reports Q2 2026 results: revenue $1.1B (+5% YoY); GAAP diluted EPS $0.52 (-27% YoY); non-GAAP diluted EPS $1.59 (-8% YoY); issues Q3 non-GAAP EPS guidance of $1.60-$1.80 and FY2026 revenue guidance of $4.445B-$4.53B
catalysts.impact: In-line/mixed quarter; cloud infrastructure segment revenue +39% YoY to $99M, security +10% YoY to $604M, delivery/other cloud apps -6% YoY to $396M
